papers.title: Mussel-Inspired Polydopamine Coating: A General Strategy To Enhance Osteogenic Differentiation and Osseointegration for Diverse Implants.
papers.abstract: Surface modifications play an important role in endowing implant surface with excellent biocompatibility and bioactivity. Among the bioinspired surface modifications, the mussel-inspired polydopamine (PDA) has aroused great interest of researchers. Herein, we fabricated PDA on diverse implant surfaces, including biopolymer, biometal, and bioceramic. Then the effects of PDA coating on cell responsive behaviors in vitro and bone formation capacity in vivo were evaluated in detail. The results showed that PDA coating was fabricated on diverse samples surface successfully, which could significantly improve the hydrophilicity of different material surfaces. Furthermore, the results indicated that PDA coating exerted direct enhancing on the adhesion, proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow derived mesenchymal stromal cells (BMSCs) through FAK and p38 signaling pathways. During the process, the focal adhesion protein expression and osteogenic-related genes expression level (e.g., ALP, BMP2, BSP, and OPN) were considerably upregulated. Most importantly, the in vivo study confirmed that PDA coating remarkably accelerated new bone formation and enhanced osseointegration performance. Our study uncovered the biological responses stimulated by PDA coating to make a better understanding of cell/tissue-PDA interactions and affirmed that PDA, a bioinspired polymer, has great potential as a candidate and functional bioactive coating medium in bone regeneration and orthopedic application.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究聚多巴胺涂层对骨整合的促进作用，但未涉及增材制造、多孔结构设计或力学测试，与AM生物医用方向的核心关注点不符。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design, and no mechanical testing (static or fatigue) relevant to stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索聚多巴胺涂层对多种植入物表面骨整合能力的增强作用。
summary_zh.method: 在生物聚合物、金属和陶瓷表面制备聚多巴胺涂层，并评估细胞响应和体内骨形成。
summary_zh.result: 聚多巴胺涂层显著促进BMSCs粘附、增殖和成骨分化，加速新骨形成。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和大鼠体内植入模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether mussel-inspired polydopamine coating can enhance osseointegration across different implant materials.
summary_en.method: Polydopamine was deposited on biopolymer, biometal, and bioceramic surfaces; in vitro cell behavior and in vivo bone formation were evaluated.
summary_en.result: PDA coating improved hydrophilicity, upregulated osteogenic genes, and accelerated new bone formation in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro BMSC assays and in vivo rat implantation models.

papers.title: Recent advances of self-assembling peptide-based hydrogels for biomedical applications.
papers.abstract: Peptide-based hydrogels have been proven to be preeminent biomedical materials due to their high water content, tunable mechanical stability, great biocompatibility and excellent injectability. The ability of peptide-based hydrogels to provide extracellular matrix-mimicking environments opens up opportunities for their biomedical applications in fields such as drug delivery, tissue engineering, and wound healing. In this review, we first describe several methods commonly used for the fabrication of robust peptide-based hydrogels, including spontaneous hydrogelation, enzyme-controlled hydrogelation and cross-linking-enhanced hydrogelation. We then introduce some representative studies on their applications in drug delivery and antitumor therapy, antimicrobial and wound healing materials, and 3D bioprinting and tissue engineering. We hope that this review facilitates the advances of hydrogels in biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇综述未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的任何应用，因此与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into bioprinting workflow, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not address autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述自组装多肽水凝胶的制备及其生物医学应用。
summary_zh.method: 描述了自组装、酶促交联等水凝胶制备方法。
summary_zh.result: 总结了水凝胶在药物递送、抗菌、3D生物打印中的代表性研究。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To review the fabrication methods and biomedical applications of self-assembling peptide-based hydrogels.
summary_en.method: The review covers spontaneous hydrogelation, enzyme-controlled hydrogelation, and cross-linking-enhanced hydrogelation techniques.
summary_en.result: Representative studies on drug delivery, antimicrobial wound healing, and 3D bioprinting are summarized.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is performed; the paper is a literature review.
